recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. The requested example is already present, in current build scope, and no follow-up source work is needed for FHIR-27745.
issue_request: FHIR-27745 is a Published/Persuasive Vocab change request asking for a FHIR-core CodeSystem example that shows how a code system supplement can provide translations from one language to another.
initial_application: The issue was applied by commit 25116d582d76323da371b049d65a2ed9879a9f91, merged as 9cb13f8784d30728074058c9600191edb0685fdd, which added source/codesystem/codesystem-example-supplement-2.xml and registered it in source/codesystem/list-CodeSystem-examples.xml. Follow-up commit d0e19110fc7d86d51a91bab51891cc6c79829ef4 added the example title to fix build issues.
additional_context: The originating Zulip thread asked for a core supplement example showing translated designations, and Confluence minutes confirm the ticket was scoped to creating an example. The current CodeSystem source folder is active because source/fhir.ini lists codesystem=CodeSystem.
reconciliation: No source change was made. CodeSystem/example-supplement-2 currently declares content=supplement, supplements=http://hl7.org/fhir/bundle-type, and German language designations, and list-CodeSystem-examples.xml includes a CodeSystem/example-supplement-2 entry.
